If the value type for a custom property is invalid,
discard the property.

-- test.glx --
person_properties:
    some_custom_property:
        label: "Custom Property"
        value_type: rabbit
persons:
    someone:
        properties:
            some_custom_property: 42

-- want-error --
persons\[someone\].Properties.some_custom_property.Value: unknown value type "rabbit"

-- want-catalog.yaml --
persons:
    someone:
        properties: {}
